description: The refusal of the move of a top-level element into a folder of another branch of the tree: a structure does not go into a Server Actions folder. The native setter of Folder does not throw (it silently swaps the folder for none), so the verb reads back, undoes and refuses, naming the branch of each. The clean path (folder of the same branch, same key) is in tests/jobs/refactor-reparent.json.
expectError: move into: IFolder 'RpActionsFolder' is a folder of the 'ServerActions' branch
A folder only holds elements of its own branch
